setup.title: Setup
setup.description: Start by optimizing the following settings for yourself:

error.title: Error
error.notfound: We could not find this page.
error.notimplemented: This feature or frame is not implemented yet.
error.injection: This error was caused by third-party content. Be careful when following instructions from this page.

game.resize: Don't resize the window while the game is running!

classic.title: CLASSIC
classic.description: WASD / Arrow keys to move and space / click to shoot

cool.title: COOL (rec)
cool.description: Mouse to move and click to shoot

secondary.title: Launch Secondary Frame
secondary.description: Launches a secondary frame to debug and test features. You can select the page you want to pop out from the dropdown menu.

controls.title: Extended Controls
controls.description: Additional controls to debug and test the webview/frame.

old.title: Launch Old Frame
old.description: Launches the discontinued UI. (Requires internet connection)

skineditor.title: Skin Editor (preview)
skineditor.description: Layer based skin editor with 3D painting, body part selection and a classic 2D pixel mode.

document.name: Project name
document.dropLayer: Drop to add as layers to this skin
document.dropTab: Drop to open in a new tab

view.noWebglHint: WebGL could not be started in this webview. The 2D editor still works.

model.hint: Arm width of the 3D model. Only changes the preview, use the converter to move pixels.

tools.mirrorHint: Paint on both sides at the same time (left ↔ right)
tools.mirrorSideHint: Copies the selected body parts of the active layer to the opposite side

pencil.name: Pencil
pencil.hint: Left click: primary color, right click (2D): secondary color

eraser.name: Eraser
eraser.hint: Removes pixels of the active layer

fill.name: Fill
fill.hint: Fills connected pixels of the same color

picker.name: Color picker
picker.hint: Picks a color from the skin. Hold Alt with any tool.

shade.name: Shade brush
shade.hint: Darkens or lightens existing pixels one step per stroke. Shift inverts.

select.name: Selection
select.hint: Selects a rectangle in the texture. Painting is limited to the selection.

move.name: Move
move.hint: Moves the selection or the whole layer. Arrow keys move by one pixel.

line.name: Line
line.hint: Draws a straight line. Shift snaps to 45°.

rect.name: Rectangle
rect.hint: Draws a rectangle. Shift fills it.

noise.name: Noise brush
noise.hint: Paints the primary color with random brightness variation (Shift+B cycles the brush tools)

replace.name: Replace color
replace.hint: Replaces every pixel with the clicked color on the active layer

hand.name: Hand
hand.hint: Moves and rotates the view with the left mouse. Hold Space for a moment.

fill.faceHint: Only fills inside the clicked cube face
fill.partHint: Fills across the faces of the clicked body part
fill.globalHint: Replaces the color on the whole layer

shade.hint: Direction of the shade brush. Shift or right click inverts it.

parts.title: Body parts
parts.selectHint: Click: only this part, Shift/Ctrl + click: add or remove
parts.head: Head
parts.overlayToggle: Show or hide the overlay of this part
parts.modeHint: How body parts that are not selected are shown

colors.title: Colors
colors.shadesHint: Darker and lighter variants of the primary color with pixel art hue shifting

layers.title: Layers
layers.legacyOverlay: 64×32 skins only have an overlay on the head. Convert the skin to 64×64 to use all overlays.

target.overlayHint: Outer layer (hat, jacket, sleeves, pants). Switching between base and overlay keeps the pixels.
target.atlasHint: Raw texture coordinates, contains both layers (imported PNGs)

convert.title: Convert skin
convert.description: Recalculates the pixels of all layers for another format or arm width.
convert.lossy: This conversion can remove pixels (overlays of 64×64 skins or the outer arm column).
convert.undoHint: The conversion can be undone with Ctrl+Z.

dialog.discard: The current skin has unsaved changes. Discard them?
dialog.closeTab: "{name}" has unsaved changes. Close it anyway?

status.hint: Left mouse paints · right mouse rotates (3D) · Space or H moves the view · Tab hides panels · F1 shows all shortcuts

help.title: Skin editor help
help.layers: Every layer renders on the base layer, the overlay or the raw atlas. Clothes can live on their own layers and be moved between base and overlay at any time without repainting.
help.mouse: 3D: left mouse paints, right mouse rotates, middle mouse pans, mouse wheel zooms. A left click next to the model rotates as well. 2D: mouse wheel zooms, middle mouse, Space or the hand tool pans. Drop files onto the canvas to add them as layers, onto the tab bar to open them.

keys.order: Move layer down / up (Shift: to bottom / top)
keys.fill: Fill selection with primary / secondary color
keys.newOpen: New skin / open (in a new tab)
keys.parts: Select a body part (Shift adds) / all parts

messages.mergeImpossible: There is no layer below to merge into.
messages.exportedTransparent: Exported. {count} base pixels are not fully opaque and may look wrong in game.
messages.wrongSize: Unsupported image size {width}×{height}, skins have to be 64×64 or 64×32.
